app: In the IAM Identity Center console go to Settings > Identity source, then Actions > Change identity source > External identity provider.

Under 'Service provider metadata' AWS shows its Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL and issuer, or a metadata file to download - copy both into the FlareID service provider. The ACS looks like https://{region}.signin.aws.amazon.com/platform/saml/acs/{id} (check your app's current UI; the host varies by region).

Under 'Identity provider metadata' either upload the file from {idp_metadata_url} or type the values: IdP SSO URL = {idp_sso_url}, IdP issuer URL = {idp_entity_id}, and the signing certificate from {idp_cert_url}.
Type CONFIRM when prompted to finish the identity-source change.
Provision users into Identity Center (SCIM or manual). A user's Identity Center username must equal the SAML NameID FlareID sends - by default that is the user's email address.
flareid: Add a SAML service provider (Admin > Applications > SAML service providers > New) and apply this template.
Replace {region} and {id} in the ACS URL with the 'Service provider metadata' values AWS shows, and fix the entity ID if AWS reports something other than urn:amazon:webservices.
Keep NameID format emailAddress so the subject matches Identity Center usernames; no extra attributes are needed for sign-in.
Only add attribute definitions if you also enable 'Attributes for access control' (ABAC) in Identity Center.
